action: A rabbit comes out from behind the door edge on the left, sits hunched near the doorway, turns its head to the right, then stretches and hops out of frame to the right.
identity_gap: The animated rabbit is a mirror of the doodle (faces right instead of left) and its body is rounder and more hunched than the doodle's long low body. The ears keep the doodle's two pointed loops, but they often cross the head line or float loose from it, which the doodle's single continuous outline does not do.
notes: Frames 1 to 2 jump from a thin upright partial figure to a full round body, and in frame 7 the ears sit detached above the back with a stray crossing stroke while the body outline changes shape abruptly. The change that would help most is keeping the ears joined to the head at a fixed attachment point so they move with the head instead of drifting across it.
